_comment: restore.c dorecover() redraws a restored level once, through docrt() (944) and the vision_full_recalc = 1 it sets at 928; see_monsters() stays deferred until moveloop. The debug-mode Valkyrie drinks a wished-for potion of hallucination, creates two monsters beside her and saves. On restore each hallucinated monster takes one display-RNG draw before the welcome --More--. The port used to run an extra vision_recalc(0) before docrt(), which spent a second draw per monster and showed different monster letters.
